title: Pizza Sauce

ingredients.title: Ingredients
items: 1 can (28 oz / 800 g) San Marzano whole peeled tomatoes (DOP if possible)
½ tsp freshly ground black pepper
1 tsp dried oregano (or 2 tsp fresh, finely chopped)
6–8 fresh basil leaves, torn by hand
½ tsp sugar (optional, only if tomatoes are overly acidic)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Drain & Crush Tomatoes
steps: Drain excess liquid from canned tomatoes (reserve in case you need to loosen sauce).
Crush tomatoes by hand or use a food mill for a smooth texture. Avoid over-pureeing; sauce should be rustic.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Infuse Oil with Garlic
steps: In a saucepan over medium-low heat, warm olive oil.
Add garlic slices and gently cook until fragrant (do not brown).

instruction.title: Step 3 – Simmer the Sauce
steps: Add crushed tomatoes, salt, pepper, and oregano.
Stir gently and bring to a soft simmer.
Cook 20–25 minutes, uncovered, until slightly thickened but still spreadable.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finish with Basil
steps: Stir in fresh basil leaves and a final drizzle of olive oil.

chefTips: Do not overcook. Unlike pasta sauce, pizza sauce should remain fresh and vibrant. Long cooking dulls the flavor.
Consistency matters: Sauce should cling lightly to a spoon, not runny but not paste-like.
No onions or butter – keep it authentic Neapolitan-style.
For wood-fired pizza ovens: Keep the sauce slightly looser, as high heat will reduce it quickly.
